In this chapter, a detailed explanation of each PyPedal class is presented, including attributes and methods.

## Animal Objects {#sec-objects-animal-objects}

Three types of animal object are provided in PyPedal (@sec-objects-animal-objects-new-animal). Users will typically work
with instances of `NewAnimal` objects, while `LightAnimal` (@sec-objects-animal-objects-light-animal) and `SimAnimal`
(@sec-objects-animal-objects-sim-animal) objects are of interest primarily to developers. Detailed descriptions of each
class and its methods may be found in the API Reference for the `pyp_newclasses` module (@sec-functions-pyp-newclasses).

### The NewAnimal Class {#sec-objects-animal-objects-new-animal}

::: {#tbl-objects-animal-objects-new-animal-attributes}
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
|              | Defaults for integer  | Defaults for string  |                                                        |
| Attribute    | IDs (`asd`)           | IDs (`ASD`)          | Description                                            |
+:=============+:=====================:+:====================:+:=======================================================+
| age          | -999                  | -999                 | The animal's age based on the global                   |
|              |                       |                      | `BASE_DEMOGRAPHIC_YEAR` defined in `pyp_demog`. If the |
|              |                       |                      | `by` is unknown, the inferred generation is used. If   |
|              |                       |                      | the inferred generation is unknown, the age is set to  |
|              |                       |                      | -999.                                                  |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| alive        | `0`                   | `0`                  | Flag indicating if an animal is alive: `0` = dead,     |
|              |                       |                      | `1` = alive.                                           |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| alleles      | `['', '']`            | `['', '']`           | Alleles used for gene dropping.                        |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| ancestor     | `0`                   | `0`                  | Flag indicating if an animal has offspring: `0` = has  |
|              |                       |                      | no offspring, `1` = has offspring. The flags are set   |
|              |                       |                      | by calling `pyp_utils.set_ancestor_flag()`.            |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| animalID     | animal ID             | animal ID $\mapsto$  | Animal's ID. Animal IDs change when a pedigree is      |
|              |                       | `integer`            | renumbered. IDs must be provided for all animals in a  |
|              |                       |                      | pedigree file. When strings are used for animal IDs    |
|              |                       |                      | with the `ASD` pedigree format code they're converted  |
|              |                       |                      | to numeric IDs with the `string_to_int()` method.      |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| bd           | `missing_bdate`       | `missing_bdate`      | The animal's birthdate in `MMDDYY` format.             |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| breed        | `missing_breed`       | `missing_breed`      | The animal's breed as a string.                        |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| by           | `missing_byear`       | `missing_byear`      | The animal's birthyear in `YYYY` format.               |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| damID        | dam ID                | dam ID $\mapsto$     | Dam's ID. When strings are provided for IDs with the   |
|              |                       | `integer`            | `ASD` pedigree format code they're converted to        |
|              |                       |                      | numeric IDs with the `string_to_int()` method.         |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| damName      | dam ID                | dam ID               | The name of the animal's dam.                          |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| daus         | `{}`                  | `{}`                 | Dictionary containing all daughters of an animal. The  |
|              |                       |                      | keys and values are the animal IDs for each offspring. |
|              |                       |                      | When the pedigree is renumbered, keys are updated to   |
|              |                       |                      | match the renumbered IDs for each offspring.           |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| fa           | `0.0`                 | `0.0`                | The animal's coefficient of inbreeding.                |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| founder      | `n`                   | `y`                  | Character indicating whether or not the animal is a    |
|              |                       |                      | founder (had unknown parents): `n` = not a founder     |
|              |                       |                      | (one or both parents known), `y` = founder (both       |
|              |                       |                      | parents unknown).                                      |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| gen          | `-999`                | `-999`               | Generation to which the animal belongs.                |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| gencoeff     | `-999.0`              | `-999.0`             | Pattie's [-@Pattie1965] generation coefficient.        |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| herd         | `missing_herd`        | `missing_herd`       | The ID of the herd to which the animal belongs.        |
|              | $\mapsto$ `integer`   | $\mapsto$            |                                                        |
|              |                       | \emph{integer}       |                                                        |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| igen         | `-999`                | `-999`               | Generation inferred by `pyp_utils.set_generation()`.   |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| name         | animal ID             | animal ID            | The animal's name.                                     |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| originalHerd | herd                  | herd                 | The original herd ID to which an animal belonged before|
|              |                       |                      | the herd was converted from a string to an integer;    |
|              |                       |                      | most useful with the `H` pedigree format code.         |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| originalID   | animalID              | animal ID $\mapsto$  | Original ID assigned to an animal. It will not change  |
|              |                       | `integer`            | when the pedigree is renumbered.                       |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| paddedID     | `animalID` $\mapsto$  | `animalID` $\mapsto$ | The animal ID padded to fifteen digits, with the       |
|              | `integer`             | `integer`            | birthyear (or 1950 if the birth year is unknown)       |
|              |                       |                      | prepended. The order of elements is: birthyear,        |
|              |                       |                      | animalID, count of zeros, zeros. Used to create the    |
|              |                       |                      | alleles for gene dropping.                             |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| pedcomp      | `-999.9`              | `-999.9`             | Pedigree completeness as described in                  |
|              |                       |                      | @sec-methodology-pedigre-completeness}.                |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| renumberedID | `-999`                | `-999`               | ID assigned to an animal when the pedigree is          |
|              |                       |                      | renumbered. The default value indicates the pedigree   |
|              |                       |                      | hasn't been renumbered using PyPedal.                  |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| sex          | `u`                   | `u`                  | The sex of the animal: `m` = male, `f` = female, `u`   |
|              |                       |                      | = unknown/not provided.                                |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| sireID       | sire ID               | sire ID $\mapsto$    | Sire's ID. When strings are provided for animal IDs    |
|              |                       | `integer`            | using the `ASD` pedigree format code they're converted |
|              |                       |                      | to numeric IDs with the `string_to_int()` method.      |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| sireName     | sireID                | sireID               | The name of the animal's sire.                         |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| sons         | `{}`                  | {}                   | Dictionary containing all known sons of an animal.     |
|              |                       |                      | The keys and values are the animal IDs for each        |
|              |                       |                      | offspring. When the pedigree is renumbered, keys are   |
|              |                       |                      | updated to correspond to the renumbered IDs for each   |
|              |                       |                      | animal.                                                |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+
| unks         | `{}`                  | {}                   | Dictionary containing all offspring of an animal with  |
|              |                       |                      | unknown sex. The keys and values are the animal IDs    |
|              |                       |                      | for each offspring. When the pedigree is renumbered,   |
|              |                       |                      | keys are updated to correspond to the renumbered IDs   |
|              |                       |                      | for each animal.                                       |
+--------------+-----------------------+----------------------+--------------------------------------------------------+

Attributes of `NewAnimal` objects..
:::

`NewAnimal` objects have the seven methods listed in @tbl-objects-animal-objects-new-animal-methods. The methods focus
on returning information about an instance of an object; calculations are left to functions in, e.g., the `pyp_metrics`
`pyp_nrm` modules.
